moves.name: David Montgomery
moves.text: Move David Montgomery (HOU RB) to IR - ESPN: "week-to-week" (Oct 12); out Weeks 6-8, back about Week 9 (Week 8 is his bye); ~9.3 a game when healthy. Yahoo tags him D today, and IR takes only a player Yahoo lists as Out or IR - move him the day Yahoo flips him; until then he sits on the bench.

moves.name: Will Shipley
moves.text: Drop candidate: Will Shipley (PHI RB) - ESPN: "sidelined multiple weeks" (Oct 12); out Weeks 6-7, back about Week 8; ~6.0 a game when healthy. No IR slot is left after the move above, so holding him costs a roster seat while he is out. The cheapest other bench seat to free instead: Mark Andrews (BAL TE), worth ~11 pts to the best lineup through Week 17. Dom's call - never an order.
